# Interview fixture: onboarding trust at Northwind Logistics

Moderator: Thanks for making time today. To start, how did your first month of onboarding feel?
P1 Dana: Honestly rough. The docs were stale and I had to ask a colleague for almost everything.
Moderator: Can you say more about what was stale?
P1 Dana: The API reference mostly. Endpoints had moved, examples were broken.
Moderator: Moving on to support. When you hit that wall, what happened when you contacted support?
P1 Dana: Support responded within the hour and walked me through it, so I kept going. That response speed built some real trust.
Moderator: How does that compare to your previous vendor?
P1 Dana: Going back to your onboarding question - much better than before. The old vendor left tickets unanswered for days, so no, I would not describe onboarding there as trustworthy.

P2 Ben: The migration tooling saved me a weekend, though the password reset flow broke twice.
Moderator: What would have made onboarding smoother for you?
P2 Ben: A checklist. Also faster answers from support during the first week.
